text.p: Yamana Resources Inc said on Thursday that drilling on its Martinetas gold property in Argentina indicates the possibility of a geologic resource of gold mineralization.
Assay results for reverse drill holes totaling 2,226 metres show all the holes were mineralized.
Martinetas is in Santa Cruz, Vanguardia, Argentina.

The best intercepts so far are 132 metres of 1.02 grams of gold per tonne including 14 metres at 4.87 grams per tonne, and 32 metres of 1.07 grams of gold per tonne, including 12 metres at 2.02 grams per tonne.
Yamana said the drilling indicates the surface gold resource is open in three directions and open in depth as well.

"Yamana has taken the first step in the development of what we believe is a signficant gold deposit discovery, in a highly prospective epithermal gold district," said Richard Walters, Yamana's chief operating officer.

Yamana said it is the operator of the Santa Cruz project in the exploration stage through an agreement with Rio Algom Ltd. Rio Algom may earn a 50 percent interest in the properties by funding US$20 million on the project before August 31, 2001.
